headline: Your DoveRunner waterfall journey.
subheadline: A scrollable GTMx strategy artifact for routing BFSI, gaming, fintech, and OTT/media accounts into the right DoveRunner mobile-app security, Multi-DRM, or complete-security offer. List building, campaign angles, and sample copy, prepared for James Sungmin Ahn, Founder & CEO.
productSummary: DoveRunner (doverunner.com; formerly INKA Entworks / AppSealing / PallyCon, rebrand effective 17 March 2025) is complete mobile application and content security SaaS. Mobile App Security: no-code / low-code Android sealing + iOS SDK, RASP, anti-tampering, anti-reverse engineering, root/jailbreak detection, real-time threat analytics, CI/CD (Jenkins, TeamCity, Crashlytics) and compliance framing (RBI, GDPR, HIPAA, SEBI, OWASP, PCI DSS). Content Security: Multi-DRM (Apple FairPlay, Google Widevine, Microsoft PlayReady, Huawei Wiseplay), Multi-DRM Client SDK, DRM License Cipher, Forensic Watermarking, Distributor Watermarking, and Anti-Piracy (DMCA monitoring/takedown). DoveRunner Complete bundles anti-piracy + forensic watermarking + Multi-DRM + mobile app security. Site proof: 1000+ global customers across 30 countries; named studios/creators AMC, Samsung, Sundance Institute; case studies include Kredivo (mobile banking), Devsisters / Cookie Run (gaming), Vidio / KMK Online (OTT), BookMyShow (entertainment + streaming), mediafellows. ~65 employees; HQ San Jose with APAC presence. James Sungmin Ahn is Founder & CEO (james.ahn@doverunner.com).
coreInsight: James sells one DoveRunner platform spanning mobile app security (ex-AppSealing) and content security / Multi-DRM (ex-PallyCon) — not a different product per vertical. BFSI vs gaming vs fintech vs OTT is a merge tag after routing, not a second waterfall. The single routing signal is competitor_security_stack: which mobile-app shielding or Multi-DRM / content-protection stack a lead source can already see (AppDome / Guardsquare / Promon / Protectt.ai family; Multi-DRM / watermarking competitors; public streaming or regulated mobile apps with no competitor brand visible; or none). That ladder maps to DoveRunner's live offers: app-shielding switch, Multi-DRM comparison, Complete security brief, then a soft remaining-TAM playbook.

sections.label: Signal
sections.title: The signal is which security stack they already run
sections.takeaway: BuiltWith, careers, job ads, SDK mentions, and DRM partner pages already show AppDome / Guardsquare / Promon / Protectt.ai, a Multi-DRM or watermarking vendor, or a public OTT / regulated mobile app with no competitor brand. That competitor_security_stack is stronger than a title guess and cheap to collect.

sections.label: Waterfall
sections.title: One cascade routes every in-TAM BFSI, gaming, fintech, and OTT account
sections.takeaway: First match wins. Mobile-app shielding competitors first, then Multi-DRM / content-security competitors, then visible streaming or regulated apps without a named competitor, then every remaining in-TAM account.

sections.label: Tiers
sections.title: Each competitor_security_stack band gets a different first offer
sections.takeaway: Shielding competitors get an App Shielding Switch Brief. Multi-DRM competitors get a Multi-DRM Comparison. Visible apps without a named competitor get the DoveRunner Complete Brief. The rest get the DoveRunner Security Playbook.

sections.label: Campaigns
sections.title: Switch the shield, win the DRM comparison, land Complete, then cover the rest
sections.takeaway: The list is always BFSI / gaming / fintech / OTT-media operators DoveRunner already sells into. Segment is a merge tag. A/Bs sit on exclusive routes (fraud / RASP vs piracy / Multi-DRM).

sections.label: Email Copy
sections.title: Copy that names the security stack already visible on their apps or streams
sections.takeaway: Notice the competitor or public-app signal, poke the fraud / tampering / piracy friction that stack implies, then ask for a one-letter yes.

sections.label: Launch
sections.title: Launch the app-shielding switch route first
sections.takeaway: Start where competitor_security_stack already shows AppDome, Guardsquare, Promon, or Protectt.ai. Prove reply density, then roll Multi-DRM comparison, Complete brief, and the remaining-TAM catch-all.

signalReasons: Apollo / LinkedIn Sales Nav (BFSI, mobile gaming, fintech / neobank, OTT / streaming / media titles: CISO, Head of Security, VP Engineering, Head of Streaming, Fraud / Trust & Safety) plus app-store / OTT directories are the TAM DoveRunner already sells into. Exact public TAM account count is not published on doverunner.com; treat size as estimated (see doverunner-magnet-flags.txt) and keep each launch tier >=~1,500 contacts where possible.

The same BuiltWith + careers + job-ad + site/SDK scrape returns competitor_security_stack: mobile_shielding (AppDome, Guardsquare DexGuard/iXGuard, Promon SHIELD, Protectt.ai, Zimperium, Digital.ai App Secure, adjacent); multi_drm (Verimatrix, Axinom, Irdeto, BuyDRM / KeyOS, Widevine/FairPlay self-run without a named Multi-DRM SaaS, forensic-watermark vendors); visible_app_no_competitor (public Android/iOS apps or streaming players in TAM with no Tier 1–2 brand); or none — enough to route without a second expensive enrichment product.

The ladder maps to live DoveRunner positioning (Mobile App Security RASP/no-code sealing, Multi-DRM + License Cipher, Forensic / Distributor Watermarking, Anti-Piracy) plus public proof language (1000+ customers / 30 countries; AMC, Samsung, Sundance Institute; case studies Kredivo, Devsisters, Vidio, BookMyShow, mediafellows).
Segment (BFSI vs gaming vs fintech vs OTT/media) and region (Americas / APAC / EU / ROW) are scrape filters and merge tags, not a second waterfall. Apollo is email last after the account is routed.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND competitor_security_family = mobile_shielding (AppDome, Guardsquare DexGuard/iXGuard, Promon SHIELD, Protectt.ai, Zimperium, Digital.ai App Secure, adjacent) AND not already_customer
routingRules.why: They already pay for a competing mobile RASP / app-shielding stack. Strongest switch intent for DoveRunner Mobile App Security (ex-AppSealing) with no-code sealing + threat analytics.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND competitor_security_family = multi_drm (Verimatrix, Axinom, Irdeto, BuyDRM/KeyOS, self-run Widevine/FairPlay/PlayReady without a named Multi-DRM SaaS, forensic-watermark competitors) AND not already_customer
routingRules.why: They run competing content security / Multi-DRM. Side-by-side DoveRunner Multi-DRM + License Cipher + Forensic Watermarking + Anti-Piracy pitch.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND app_or_stream_visible = true AND competitor_security_family = none AND not already_customer

routingRules.if: in_tam AND none of the above

tiers.name: Tier 1
tiers.label: Mobile app shielding competitor detected
tiers.trigger: competitor_security_stack shows AppDome, Guardsquare, Promon, Protectt.ai, Zimperium, Digital.ai, or adjacent; in-TAM BFSI/gaming/fintech/OTT; not already a DoveRunner customer
tiers.pain: They are already funding a competing RASP / app-shielding vendor and still feel lock-in, SDK friction, or gaps when modding, Frida, root/jailbreak, and payment-crack attacks keep landing on production apps.
tiers.valueProp: App Shielding Switch Brief: DoveRunner Mobile App Security as no-code / low-code sealing + RASP + real-time threat analytics with migration framing and named peer proof (Kredivo, Devsisters).
tiers.dataSource: BuiltWith + Jobs/site scrape for AppDome / Guardsquare / Promon / Protectt.ai mentions
tiers.replyDensity: Highest - they already budget mobile app security
tiers.accounts: est. flagged; not published on doverunner.com — keep each tier >=~1,500 contacts before launch when the TAM allows

tiers.name: Tier 2
tiers.label: Multi-DRM / content security competitor detected
tiers.trigger: competitor_security_stack shows Verimatrix, Axinom, Irdeto, BuyDRM/KeyOS, self-run Widevine/FairPlay/PlayReady without named Multi-DRM SaaS, or forensic-watermark competitors; no Tier-1 shielding match
tiers.pain: Competing or DIY Multi-DRM usually means license sprawl, weak watermarking/takedown, and studio/licensor pressure when live and VOD leaks keep showing up on Telegram and pirate CDNs.
tiers.valueProp: Multi-DRM Comparison: one-pager contrasting DoveRunner Multi-DRM + License Cipher + Forensic Watermarking + Anti-Piracy against their current stack (peer framing: Vidio, BookMyShow, AMC/Samsung/Sundance language on site).
tiers.dataSource: Same competitor_security_stack scrape for Multi-DRM / watermark / anti-piracy brands
tiers.replyDensity: High - visible stack, active switching market

tiers.name: Tier 3
tiers.label: Visible app / stream, no named competitor
tiers.trigger: Public Android/iOS app or streaming player in TAM with competitor_security_family = none and no Tier 1-2 match
tiers.pain: Shipping consumer apps or streams without a named shielding/DRM brand usually means fraud, modded clients, and piracy risk show up only after incidents — while compliance (RBI/GDPR/HIPAA/PCI) and studio deals still expect proof.
tiers.valueProp: DoveRunner Complete Brief: path into Mobile App Security + Multi-DRM / watermarking / anti-piracy under one brand (ex-AppSealing + PallyCon), with 30-day trial language from pricing page.
tiers.dataSource: App-store + OTT site scrape after in_tam gate with no competitor brand
tiers.replyDensity: Medium - clear gap, longer education cycle

tiers.name: Catch-all
tiers.label: Remaining in-TAM BFSI / gaming / fintech / OTT accounts
tiers.trigger: in_tam BFSI, gaming, fintech, or OTT/media account with Security/Eng/Fraud buyer and no Tier 1-3 competitor_security_stack match
tiers.pain: Most regulated or content-heavy operators know mobile fraud and piracy are expensive but have not publicly exposed a shielding or Multi-DRM brand — so incidents and licensing friction stay reactive.
tiers.valueProp: Soft DoveRunner Security Playbook: practical paths into Mobile App Security and Content Security — soft CTA, site proof of 1000+ customers across 30 countries.
